action_items: No code changes required — the source-aware Membership UI, paywall price consistency, and email-claim safety are all working exactly per spec. Cleared for App Store resubmission from a UI/regression standpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: MoreScreens.tsx MembershipScreen — footer conditional (source==='iap' vs Stripe) reads Platform.OS at render for the Google/Apple wording. On web preview Platform.OS==='web' so the fallback selects Apple ID/App Store — this happens to match the M2 spec but a native Android IAP user would still show Apple wording on web. Non-blocking for App Store review (iOS build renders 'ios'). Consider deriving the store label from the IAP payload's `platform` field instead of Platform.OS for cross-store correctness. Reference: /app/frontend/src/screens/MoreScreens.tsx:352.

PaywallScreen.tsx line 237: big price card falls back to '$90' when annualPkg is undefined, while the Subscribe button (line 276) falls back to '$90.00' via iapPrice default. These fallbacks diverge — if RC ever fails to load the offering, the card shows $90 and the button shows $90.00/year. Non-blocking (both display in preview because RC is loaded), but recommend making both use the same iapPrice constant.
shadow* style prop deprecation warnings persist across the app; Expo 51+ recommends `boxShadow`. Non-blocking but noisy in console.
